sections.en:
4 νουμασίας ('of the naming') the codex has, ὀνομασίας ('of the naming') we have written (and thus elsewhere). 8 τῆς ... οὔση ('to the ... being') the codex has, τοῖς
... οὖσι ('to the ... being') we have written. 9 the codex has εἰκόναν ('image'). 19 ἁʹ κερέα ('first horn') the codex has, πρώτη κεραίᾳ ('first horn') we have written.
20 ὑμάγεινε ('image') = imaginem ('image'). 22 ἀγγέλους ('angels') the codex has, ἀγγέλων ('of angels') we have written. in the codex after
☾ καὶ ('Moon and') the repeated words καὶ ἀγγέλων ('and of angels') (sc. ἀγγέλους ('angels')) ♃ καὶ ('Jupiter and') which we have deleted. 23 τῶν
σῶν πρὸς κεφάλων ('of your pillows') the codex has, τὸ σὸν προσκέφαλον ('your pillow') we have written. Cf. τὰ προσκέφαλα ('the pillows').
27 παρθένον ('virgin') i. e. sine macula ('without spot'); cf. below 45, 22 and 29. 30 τῆς ... ἑτέρας ('of the ... other') genitive for
dative (Cumont).

summary.headline: Planetary Image Magic
summary.text: Magical procedures using planetary hours, zodiacal signs, engraved characters, divine or angelic names, blood, saffron, and laurel charcoal to produce attraction, favor, divination through dreams, secret knowledge, and beauty. Instructions invoke Venus, Saturn, Moon, Jupiter, Mercury, Aries, Taurus, Aquarius, Gemini, Capricorn, and Cancer.
